# `^B2` – Interleaved 2 of 5 Bar Code

[Overview](../README.md) · [Libraries](../libraries/README.md) · [Commands](README.md) · [Features](../features/README.md) · [Evidence legend](../METHODOLOGY.md) · [Compare images](../../benchmarks/accuracy/comparisons/README.md)


Print an Interleaved 2 of 5 barcode, a high-density self-checking continuous numeric symbology.

Reference parameters: **o, h, f, g, e, j**. These describe the reference grammar, not a promise that any library honors every parameter. [Zebra guide, page 68](../../zpl-zbi2-pg-en.pdf).
